text_block_list.text: It was after celebrating our second New Year together with Believe—
(Swish, swish, swish...)
(Swish, swish, swish...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Hm!? Wh-What's that!?
Hm!? Wh-What!?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you being so fidgety?
choice_data_list: N-No, wait... I'm waiting for an important call!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

However, I don't tell her whose message I'm waiting for.
...Since I have the chance, I want to surprise her!

...Indeed, the new year!
Which means the URA Award selections have begun!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
"If we can win the Sprinters Stakes just like this,
you know, THAT! Couldn't we aim for that!?"

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
You know, that thing, umm...
What was it called again, for New Year's... Right!

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text: The "URA Awards"!!
Since then, Believe overcame a grueling schedule and brilliantly claimed the title of Sprint Queen at the Sprinters Stakes.

It is safe to say she has built up an impeccable record
worthy of selection for the URA Awards!
choice_data_list: All that's left is to wait for the call...!

text_block_list.text: ...Or so I thought, but—
(Swish, swish, swish...)
(Swish, swish, swish...)
(Swish, swish, swish...)
To my dismay, no contact came............ None at all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be taking my leave now.
See you tomorrow, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah. Get home safe...
Y-Yeah. Get home safely...

text_block_list.text: Even after seeing Believe off, I stayed behind, holding my smartphone up where it was easy to see and checking it over and over, but—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“—Trainer~?
It's almost lights out, you know...”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Trainer? Are you alright?
You look a bit pale..."
choice_data_list: Uh, well...

text_block_list.text: Even so... no message ever came.

For the next few days, I spent practically every spare moment staring at my phone screen.
Checking for incoming calls and sighing each time...

"Maybe the screening process is just taking longer this year?"
"Maybe they got my contact info wrong?"
Considering all kinds of possibilities like that...

Anyway, I waited, and waited, and kept on waiting.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, let us welcome them to the stage!
Here are the Umamusume chosen for the prestigious 'URA Awards', along with their Trainers!”
(Clap clap clap clap clap clap...!!)

...And that was the scene
I ended up watching through the television screen.
choice_data_list: (Wh-wha... Why!?!?)

text_block_list.text:
I screamed internally, but reaching this point left no room for doubt.
Believe was... out of the running!
Of course, the URA Award selection considers various factors beyond just race records. Winning a GⅠ doesn't necessarily guarantee selection, but—

Even so, Believe's hard work over the past year
deserved immense praise.
choice_data_list: (I never imagined it would lead to a result like this...)

text_block_list.text:
My shoulders slump in defeat.
All the strength drains from my body...
Having bet on the final chance that the award notification might arrive today, the celebratory decorations now simply felt hollow...
choice_data_list: (Even Believe has got to be in shock...)

text_block_list.text:
And as for Believe, who had come out
to meet her with a worried expression...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me. Trainer,
Happy New Year.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...You really went all out with the decorations. Quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the TV... it's the awards ceremony.
Come to think of it, that was today.

That was literally all she said regarding the matter.
After that, she didn't seem to care in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh, this mochibana decoration... is really well-made.
Did you buy it? Which shop was it from?

...In fact, if anything, my interest had already
shifted toward the New Year's decorations
I had put up in a near-frenzied state of celebration!
choice_data_list: D... Doesn't that bother you?
D... Doesn't that bother you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...I'm sorry, what do you mean?

Looking at her utterly baffled expression,
I stammer out an explanation—about the URA Awards,
and how, somehow, she hadn't been selected.
And then, despite how cluttered the explanation was, they listened attentively all the way to the end before—
Believe stated it clearly and decisively, yet somehow with a gentle tone.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I don't really mind, personally. Not at all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...I am aware we are being watched.
Races are, by nature, spectacles after all.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If one is glorious, if one is great, one is praised.
Some seek that out. It is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: However—that's not why I run.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, above all else...
I—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Seeing it through to the end is my only pride.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I ran through the Sprinters Stakes to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
With a body honed through discipline.
Never breaking, never disturbing, fiercely protecting the form I found.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I... was able to run fastest right there.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: How was it for you?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: How was—that job?
choice_data_list: ...That is—

text_block_list.text:
It feels just like last year's Fan Appreciation Festival.
It seems Believe has taught me a lesson once again.

Even after standing on the highest stage in the racing world,
Believe's attitude remains unchanged.
She is always, unwaveringly—
She keeps her eyes fixed solely upon her own duty.
...And it's because I—more than anyone—want to be someone she truly considers a partner.
choice_data_list: The "Sprinters Stakes" was a top-notch performance.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: —Yes.
choice_data_list: We really did it! We saw it through!
We saw it through to the end!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes. I think so too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
—That's why it's fine.
Everything after that, I mean.

Believe quietly added that.
Watching her, my hand naturally reached for the TV remote—

She abruptly turned off the screen,
which had been endlessly broadcasting that dazzling spectacle.

Now then, pulling ourselves together,
let's enjoy a modest New Year's holiday with Believe from here on out.
choice_data_list: Let's go eat something fancy!
Come to think of it, you were worried about the New Year's decorations, weren't you?
Come to think of it, you were worried about the New Year's decorations, weren't you?
...Hm? Is it just me, or is it getting noisy outside...?

text_block_list.text:
Now then, pulling ourselves together,
let's enjoy a modest New Year's holiday with Believe from here on out.
choice_data_list: Let's go eat something fancy!
Come to think of it, you were worried about the New Year's decorations, weren't you?
Come to think of it, you were worried about the New Year's decorations, weren't you?
...Hm? Is it just me, or is it getting noisy outside...?

text_block_list.text:
The academy is still on winter break, but the New Year's three-day period has passed.
The various restaurants and eateries should be opening back up soon.
choice_data_list: Let's go all out today!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let loose and...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Then Trainer,
are you feeling hungry?"

Caught off guard by the question, I hesitate for a moment before nodding firmly.
My mind has been so consumed with the awards ceremony these past few days
that I could barely keep any food down.
choice_data_list: To be honest, I'm pretty starving...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: That... sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Then let's go together.
It's not eating out, but...
I actually just got a message a moment ago.
choice_data_list: Huh, a message...?

text_block_list.name: Kiyomi
text_block_list.text:
—Here you go, extra simmered veggies coming right up~~!
Oh, Trainer, aren't your chopsticks slowing down?
Eat up, eat up!!
choice_data_list: M-Munch...! (H-Huh, yes...!)

text_block_list.name: Takeo-san
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, the crab is boiled and ready!
Believe-chan, you can still eat more, right?!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you for the food.

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming, you two.
I was surprised I didn't get chosen for a URA Award,
but—

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
"Then we'll celebrate twice as hard!
No, ten times—a hundred times harder!"

text_block_list.name: Harue
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, Trainer, eat up, eat up!
You made sure to come on an empty stomach, right?"

"...And so, we were treated to a dizzying array
of warm, home-cooked dishes."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes.
You made all of this, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I guess... I just got totally absorbed in it.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So you bought them all up.
...Which store was it?
And so, with Believe looking unusually curious, we arrived at a shop to buy New Year's decorations together.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? You're the one from the other day!
Ahaha, you bought so much from us~. Thank you!
choice_data_list: Not at all, thank you for back then.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, likewise!
And... who's this little Umamusume over here?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meet you. I'm Believe.
Sorry for the sudden visit.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Are these goods... made here?

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's right! We sell Japanese sweets and miscellaneous goods, and it's aaall handmade.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, they showed on TV how fascinating it is to make Japanese sweets...
Oh, young lady, did you perhaps come here to see that too?"

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: No. I mean the Japanese-style goods.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I think they are all wonderfully crafted.
From the natural swell of the mochi balls to the vibrant colors.
...You don't often see handiwork this meticulous.

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Oh... My goodness, oh my...!
Ehehe, I'm kind of really happy!!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
My older sister runs the Japanese sundries part.
Only my wagashi ended up getting famous,
so I've been feeling a bit frustrated about that, but—

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Well, aren't you a unique one!
Say, why don't you come inside for a bit?
Feel free to take a peek around the workshop!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? ...I'd love to.
choice_data_list: (Believe... Her eyes are sparkling.)

text_block_list.text:
It seems we're going to have an even better time than I expected.
Thinking that, I followed after Believe.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, that's—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Are you interested?
Well then, let's go."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, here we go!
Squish! Squish!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho! Heave-ho!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ It's gotten plenty chewy and soft now!!
Everyone, feel free to dig in!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"There's soy sauce, kinako flour...
and red bean paste too.
Please eat as much as you like♪"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"‘Yay~~~~~♡’
‘Thanks, Biko-chan and everyone♪’"
choice_data_list: I see, you were making mochi.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!! Believe-senpai and the others~~~!
You actually came!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Hello.
Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm not tired yet!
A hero is invincible, after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Actually... Alright!
Believe-senpai, could you wait here for a sec!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna whip up another batch of freshly pounded mochi
for all our senpais!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? No, not to that extent—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: No, I want to give it to them!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Believe-senpai had an incredible run in the Sprinters Stakes, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here's a "You did super awesome!!" reward
from me! Pretty great, huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Then, at least... let me help. I'll take the next turn flipping it over.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You sure about that?
I'm pretty fast, ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm fine. ...Please, go ahead.

And so, Believe managed to keep up with
Biko Pegasus's impressive fast mochi pounding.
